newsitem.title: USA: Network Long Distance sees $60 mln in revs.
newsitem.headline: Network Long Distance sees $60 mln in revs.

text.p: Network Long Distance Inc said on Monday that its tentative deal to merge with United WATS Inc should increase annual revenues of the combined companies to $60 million.
Terms of the deal, which was announced in September, have not been disclosed.

United WATS, which has about $21 million in annual revenues, is an independent inter-exchange carrier based in Kansas City, Mo., which provides long distance, travel card and ancillary services to more than 10,000 small business and commercial customers nationwide.
Network Long Distance said it will hold a conference call November 19, at 1100 EST about the pending deal and other issues.
